description: Removes placeholder setting from an item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout holding the placeholder setting. If 'true', the final layout is used, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The id of the item to remove placeholder settings from. Supply this or path.

key.description: The placeholder setting key to remove.

path.description: The path of the item to remove placeholder settings from. Supply this or id.

uniqueId.description: The placeholder setting unique id to remove.

name: presentation-remove-placeholder-setting
